svg.title: From text to numbers: 36 bytes become 12 tokens under GPT-4's tokenizer
svg.desc: The line hello123!!!? (안녕하세요!) 😉 on its way into GPT-4's tokenizer. Its 36 UTF-8 bytes are grouped into 12 tokens: hello, 123, !!!, ?, space plus bracket, four byte fragments that make up 안 and 녕, 하세요 as one token, !) and space plus emoji. Each token gets an id such as 15339, and each id picks one row of the embedding table.
svg.text: From text to numbers: 36 bytes become 12 tokens under GPT-4's tokenizer

text.tspan: marks a space. The space before ( and before the emoji is glued to the next token.
Each strip is one row of the embedding table, which has one row per token in the vocabulary (about 100,000 here).
are each cut into two tokens that are pieces of one character.
(three characters, 9 bytes) is a single token.

svg.text: Example from Karpathy's minbpe README (cl100k_base). Byte groups checked by running js-tiktoken, 2026-09-23.
